name: lazarus
description: Proof-checked historical Ethereum fixtures with exact-request replay, no live fallback, and preservation releases a stranger can check.

interface.shortDescription: Proof-checked historical Ethereum fixtures with exact-request replay, no live fallback, and preservation releases a stranger can check.
interface.longDescription: Lazarus captures the finite historical Ethereum state and exact JSON-RPC evidence one application test needs, checks account and storage claims through EIP-1186, and can reconstruct a full ordered receipt witness against the named header's receiptsRoot. Only the scoped consensus receipt payload and log projection enter the receipt-trie-proved class; transaction hashes, calls, traces and unrelated RPC fields remain recorded evidence. Fixtures are deterministic and digest-bound, exact captured requests replay over loopback, and an uncaptured request fails visibly without a live provider fallback.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $lazarus to capture, verify or replay this finite historical Ethereum fixture without a live replay fallback.
